optimizedContext.value:
# Repository

## Rules
- `RepositoryConfig`: `workspace`, `ownership: owned|shared|readOnly`, `isExternal`, `configPath` (abs config dir).
- Abstract class (not interface); ctor sets four invariants; accessors: `workspace()`, `ownership()`, `isExternal()`, `configPath()` — immutable, private fields.
- Subclasses declare storage ops; base has none. Export `ReadOnlyWorkspaceError extends DomainError` (message-only ctor).
- Shared types: `ListCursor { key, id? }`, `ListOptions { limit?, page?, after? }`, `ListMeta`, `ListResult<T>`.
- Omit `limit` → full set; `meta.limit`=`meta.count`=`meta.total`. `page` 1-based XOR `after`; `page` without `limit` invalid. `after` exclusive keyset; with/without limit as specified.
- `meta.after` = cursor of last returned item when more remain; omit at end. Never echo request cursor.
- Cursor keys: Active/Drafts/Discarded/Archive ISO timestamps + change `name`; Specs capability path, no id.
- `invalidateCache()`: default no-op; subclasses MAY invalidate adapter caches.

## Constraints
- No storage ops on base. Accessors are methods not props. `RepositoryConfig` plain interface. List types exported from module.
